# Third-party libraries

Header-only libraries bundled with DaPPA. Each is distributed under its own
license.

| Library | Version | Use | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `catch.hpp` | Catch2 v2.13.9 | Test framework | Boost Software License 1.0 | https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2 |
| `inja.hpp` | Inja 3.3 | Template engine for the DPU code | MIT | https://github.com/pantor/inja |
| `nlohmann/json.hpp` | 3.11.2 | JSON (template data, recipes) | MIT | https://github.com/nlohmann/json |
| `incbin.h` | | Embeds the DPU template into the library | Unlicense (public domain) | https://github.com/graphitemaster/incbin |
